verdict.rationale: Databricks documents budgets that monitor account-wide spending or filtered spending by team, project, or workspace. That covers the 'budgets' element, but only as tracking and monitoring, with no evidence that a budget halts compute. Per-second billing limits waste at the margin, but nothing in the pack shows a mechanism that actually stops a runaway query or idle compute overnight. Missing for 10: auto-suspend/auto-termination of idle clusters or warehouses, query timeouts or kill limits for runaway queries, budget-triggered enforcement or alerting that stops spend, independent corroboration.
